field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: CT economic nexus threshold: $500,000 gross receipts (higher than typical)

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: CT additions: federal interest, bonus depreciation addback, etc.

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: CT tax credits: R&D, jobs, film, manufacturing credits, etc.

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: CT subtractions: municipal interest, CT NOL, etc.

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: CT corporate tax rate: 7.5% flat rate (CT Gen. Stat. § 12-214)

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: CT has no transaction count threshold (only receipts-based)
